Pathology & Laboratory Medicine
Pathology & Laboratory Medicine Institute Menu
Cleveland Clinic’s Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine touches virtually every patient at Cleveland Clinic and thousands of patients across the world.
Lab Appointments & Locations
Why Choose the Department of Pathology & Laboratory Medicine?
The Department of Pathology & Laboratory Medicine (PLM) touches virtually every patient at Cleveland Clinic and thousands of patients across the world.
With approximately 2,200 dedicated caregivers processing more than 20 million tests annually, the PLM laboratories are often cited as the largest volume hospital laboratory in the United States.
PLM also provides pathology and laboratory services to external clients through our reference laboratory, Cleveland Clinic Laboratories.
We can help you choose the top specialist from our pool of pathologists and other researchers, including clinical and anatomic.

source_status.label: Laboratory Medicine
signals: Department of Laboratory Medicine | Cleveland Clinic
Pathology & Laboratory Medicine
Pathology & Laboratory Medicine Institute Menu
Department of Laboratory Medicine
Laboratory Medicine Overview
The Department of Laboratory Medicine is responsible for quantitative and qualitative analysis and interpretation of patient specimens, including tissue, blood, urine, and other body fluids.
Approximately 10 million clinical laboratory test results per year are performed in the laboratories.
The Department of Laboratory Medicine has been at the forefront of introducing new testing methods for clinical and research uses at Cleveland Clinic.
In addition to providing an ever-expanding menu of tests available for clinical use, Laboratory Medicine provides the facilities and expertise to support translational research projects.
Productive collaborative multidisciplinary research working groups are functioning with clinical departments and the Lerner Research Institute at Cleveland Clinic .
